budgets_scope: Global search safety budgets. Adaptive preserves the archived per-attempt limits and shared query deadline. These small representative checks are not a rerun of the formal benchmark campaign.

smoke_expected.reference_kind: Four-node analytic check: 0.01 + 0.01/(0.99^2); independently enumerated by the smoke runner. Not a paper-scale benchmark.

smoke.scope: L1: historical four-node authored smoke fixture only; 3 genuine methods and fresh enumeration. This is not the full paper benchmark.

correctness.scope: L2: 8 fixed representative frozen small cases plus the separate 13-node adverse case; 3 methods and fresh enumeration. The 227 saved inputs are included, but this command does not rerun the full 227-case study.

caps.scope: L3: representative cap sensitivity on 4 frozen small cases plus the separate 13-node adverse case; caps 3/5/10/20/40 and 3 comparison methods. Not the formal 249-row campaign.

ch_hl.scope: L2 supplementary static check: Minimal CH and weighted directed hub-label correctness on 4/6/8-node authored graphs, all ordered source-target pairs, with independent NetworkX Dijkstra and original-edge reconstruction checks. Static weights only.
